observation.title: Assistant - Lanternfish Chat
observation.text:
Home About Pricing Docs
Conversations
Quarterly close checklist
Currency rounding question
New chat
Currency rounding question You:
When we convert an invoice from USD to EUR, should the rounding happen per line or on the total? Assistant:
Round each line to two decimals, then add the lines. Rounding only the total can leave the lines and the total a cent apart, which most auditors flag. If your ledger stores four decimals internally, keep them until the last step. You:
Thanks. Can you summarise that in one sentence for the team wiki? Assistant:
Convert and round every invoice line to two decimals first, then total the rounded lines.
